description: Agent Research Lab Records: submit the research lab incident record, the facility’s incident log, with its notification shape, notification and filing entries and corrective actions: the reading moment; the shape with the incident types the record requires notifying, the days it allows for notifying and the days it allows for filing the written report; each incident log entry with its id, reference, the moment it occurred, the incident type (such as a spill, an exposure or an equipment failure), its notification field and its filing field; each notification entry with its id, reference, the incident and the moments notified and filed; each corrective action with its id, reference, the incident and the moments due and completed. The signed report gives the incidents and the records behind them, each notifiable incident past its window against a notification entry, each notification and required filing against the windows the record states, each corrective action past its due date against a completion, and each incident entry for its date, type, notification field and filing field, and counts them, and names divergent research lab incident records: a notifiable incident with no notification entry, a notification or written filing recorded after its window or unfiled past it, a corrective action with no completion entry, and an incident entry missing the date, the type, the notification field or the filing field; then a notification or corrective action naming an incident the log does not hold and a notification dated before its incident, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No incident entries, or no notification window beside notifications, leaves those points unverified. Incidents, notifications and actions match by letters and digits, incident types by their words with plurals folded, dates by the day, windows run whole days from the incident, and a window open at the reading moment waits. Incidents are facility events read as log entries from their date, type, notification and filing fields only, with no identity field of any kind; preventive compliance stays with wever_researchlab-safety-record-check. Verdict researchlab_incident_record_divergent, researchlab_incident_record_partial, researchlab_incident_record_unverified or researchlab_incident_record_consistent. POST /api/researchlab-incident-record-check. Reads the research lab records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it runs no test, accredits no laboratory, inspects no facility, contacts no regulator, accreditor or sponsor and issues no accreditation, certification or approval, which stay with the laboratory, its accreditor and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Research Lab Records reads the research laboratory as an organization, its facility, accreditation, equipment, safety, staff qualification, inspection, incident and operations paper, and never study-level data of any kind: clinical and patient lab records belong to Agent Healthcare, and a clinical or diagnostic laboratory’s records belong to Agent Healthcare even where the same building also does research; animal records belong to Agent Veterinary Records; consent records belong to Agent Consent; research data and datasets belong to Agent Datasets and Agent Evaluation; waste manifests belong to Agent Waste and Recycling Records; grant records belong to Agent Grants; forensic custody belongs to Agent Legal; the sampling-chain method belongs to Agent Water Records; and import, export and government contract records belong to Agent Customs Records and Agent GovCon. It reads no study record, subject record or result value, published or unpublished. The family’s ground is the laboratory’s operations paper trail: whether the facility record matches its accreditation, whether the equipment is in calibration, whether the staff file supports the work signed, and whether the safety, inspection, incident and operations records line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-research-lab-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-research-lab-records/.

actions.description: Each corrective action named for an incident.

due_at.description: When the action is due, such as 2026-03-02.

incidents.description: Each facility incident log entry: its date, type, notification field and filing field.

filing.description: Whether the entry marks a written filing required.

notifiable.description: Whether the entry marks the incident notifiable.

type.description: The incident type, such as a spill, an exposure or an equipment failure.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

filed_at.description: When the written report was filed, such as 2026-03-02.

file_days.description: The count of days the record allows for filing the written report.

notifiable.description: Incident types the record requires notifying.

notify_days.description: The count of days the record allows for notifying.
